author: NETWORG
name: Power Platform: Code App
description: Creates a code-based Power App project: .csproj (net462, ProjectType=CodeApp) + power.config.json (appId, displayName, environment, build paths). Use when building a .NET code app for Power Platform.

AppName.description: Logical name of the app, without the publisher prefix (e.g. warehousepicking). Used as-is for the schema name, the generated .meta.xml file name, and the package folder when this project is referenced from a Solution project. Must be unique among all Code Apps referenced by the same solution.
